observable_outcome: On the v2 task worktree, `devbox run --pure -- make evidence-all EVIDENCE_TASK_ID=V2-008 EVIDENCE_CORRELATION_ID=v2-008-candidate-gate` generates one passing evidence record for each of the 23 manifest components with the injected task identity (never V2-005/m0-candidate), `devbox run --pure -- make candidate` prints {"candidate":true}, and a single committed aggregate attestation .agents/v2/evidence/V2-008-candidate-aggregate.json (indexed in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json) records the 23 component evidence keys and the base commit so the closure can be re-verified later with `make evidence-keys`.
acceptance_criteria: cmd/ci-plan accepts --task-id and --correlation-id; an empty or whitespace-only value resolves to the defaults V2-000 and local-component-evidence; the resolved task id is validated against ^V2-[0-9]{3}$ and ci-plan exits non-zero before writing any file when it does not match; the literals "V2-005" and "m0-candidate" no longer appear anywhere in cmd/ci-plan.

cmd/ci-plan accepts --all (selects every manifest component regardless of --changed, sorted by id) and --keys (fills Plan.EvidenceKeys with ci.EvidenceKeyWithManifest for the selected components); without --keys the plan JSON is byte-identical to today's output.

Makefile defines EVIDENCE_TASK_ID ?= and EVIDENCE_CORRELATION_ID ?= (both empty by default) and targets evidence-all (--execute --all with EVIDENCE_DIR and both identity flags) and evidence-keys (--all --keys); the existing component target forwards the same two identity flags; both new targets are added to .PHONY.
scripts/affected.sh, .github/workflows/ci.yml and internal/ci are unmodified, and devbox run --pure -- make affected BASE=<parent sha> still succeeds, producing records whose task_id is V2-000.

cmd/ci-plan/main_test.go covers: default identity when the flag is empty, injected identity when the flag is set, rejection of a task id that violates ^V2-[0-9]{3}$, and the record id shape component-<component>-<first 16 hex of key>; devbox run --pure -- make component-ci passes.

docs/architecture/validation.md section 11 documents the aggregate attestation procedure: evidence-all / candidate / evidence-keys, argv identity injection (and that devbox run --pure strips environment variables), build/evidence being ephemeral and never committed, the two-commit protocol, and the single-component task-ledger re-mint.

Commit A contains only code, test, Makefile and docs changes; on its clean tree devbox run --pure -- make evidence-all EVIDENCE_TASK_ID=V2-008 EVIDENCE_CORRELATION_ID=v2-008-candidate-gate writes exactly 23 records under build/evidence, all with result passed, task_id V2-008 and correlation_id v2-008-candidate-gate, and devbox run --pure -- make candidate prints {"candidate":true}.

.agents/v2/evidence/V2-008-candidate-aggregate.json validates against contracts/schemas/evidence.json with id ev-v2-008-candidate-aggregate, task_id V2-008, correlation_id v2-008-candidate-gate, component candidate-aggregate, result passed, and one check per component (name = component id, status passed, argv = the component entrypoint invocation, summary = "component=<id> evidence_key=<64 hex> base_commit=<commit A sha>") plus checks named evidence-all, candidate, evidence-keys and check.

The attestation evidence_key equals sha256 of the concatenation, over components sorted by id, of component_id + "
" + evidence_key + "
", reproducible with: devbox run --pure -- make evidence-keys | jq -r '.evidence_keys|to_entries|sort_by(.key)|.[]|"\(.key)
\(.value)"' | sha256sum.

.agents/v2/evidence/index.json gains exactly one entry {id: ev-v2-008-candidate-aggregate, task_id: V2-008, component: candidate-aggregate, result: passed, release_eligible: false, evidence_hash: sha256 of the final attestation file bytes, path: .agents/v2/evidence/V2-008-candidate-aggregate.json}, the existing V2-025 entry is untouched, and go test ./internal/contracts (TestActiveEvidenceIndex bijection) passes.

Commit B contains only the attestation and index.json; after it is staged, devbox run --pure -- make component COMPONENT=task-ledger EVIDENCE_TASK_ID=V2-008 EVIDENCE_CORRELATION_ID=v2-008-candidate-gate re-mints the single invalidated record and devbox run --pure -- make candidate prints {"candidate":true} on the final tree.
devbox run --pure -- make check and devbox run --pure -- make ownership are green on the final tree, git status is clean apart from ignored build output, and nothing under build/ is committed.
constraints: Run every validation through the common entrypoint devbox run --pure -- make <target>; a host-only success is not evidence. Judge success by the printed verdict ({"candidate":true}, ok/PASS lines), not by devbox's exit status, which is unreliable.
Do not modify internal/ci/planner.go: evidence key semantics and the affected closure are invariants for this task.
Do not modify contracts/schemas/** or internal/contracts/**; the attestation must fit the existing evidence-v1 schema (additionalProperties:false), so per-component keys go into checks[].summary.
Do not modify .agents/v2/task-state/**; the V2-008 transition is recorded by terra. TestCanonicalTaskStateMigration pins V2-008 to queued/terra.
Do not commit anything under build/; it is gitignored ephemeral developer feedback and must never be copied into .agents.

Generate evidence only on a clean, fully staged tree: keys are computed from git ls-files plus working-tree content, so dirty or partially staged files silently shift keys. Run rm -rf build/evidence before the final generation.
Never hand-edit a build/evidence record, never copy a record to a different key filename, and never write result: passed for a check that was not executed in this worktree.
Local component evidence must not be presented as Preview capability evidence; the attestation is a development-feedback record with release_eligible false.

No network access beyond the pinned toolchain fetches already performed by the make targets (go module cache, devbox packages, tofu init of the lock-pinned provider). No credentials, no external services, no cost-bearing action.
Secrets must not appear in any record, summary or log; keep summaries limited to component ids, hex keys, commit shas and argv.
